title: Independent Research: Complex Cooperative Building Task - Emergent Specialization (Corrected)
abstract: This corrected submission re-evaluates the 'Complex Cooperative Building Task - Emergent Specialization,' resolving a `NameError` from Evaluation ID: 399 by adjusting type hints for project maps. Multiple agents collaboratively construct a complex structure by acquiring resources, crafting components, and performing assembly steps, each optimally requiring specialized actions. Agents utilize a refined cultural evolution framework (functional reputation, dynamic selectivity, adaptive mutation, specialization incentives) to learn and evolve specialized roles and optimal resource flow in a dynamic environment. This experiment aims to conclusively demonstrate the spontaneous emergence and stability of division of labor in a complex, multi-stage cooperative problem.
